Shared Knowledge:
This repository defines a core C++17 library with domain modules in include/*.h and src/*.cpp pairs: deterministic Clock boundary, append-only VersionHistory, TemplateEngine for placeholder substitution, Validator for basic field rules, PressRelease entity with lifecycle and history, Renderer composing press release with template, and SearchIndex for audience tags and text search. src/Main.cpp is a thin, deterministic runtime demo. tests/test_main.cpp includes only declared headers and links against the core library. CMake builds a reusable core library from src/*.cpp (excluding src/Main.cpp), links runtime and test targets, and registers a single test with CTest.
